name: an-ambient-theme-holds-after-a-profile-round-trip
description: Alpha (Default profile) wears a light ambient theme, Bravo (Second profile) a dark ambient one. After a trip to Bravo and back, Alpha's backdrop must drift slowly, not flip between light and dark. The recorded bug: the backdrop flipped every few hundred ms while nothing changed.

actions.note: gate: the app is up on Alpha's own tab
ssh-launched Atrium is not frontmost on a clean snapshot
into Bravo, which belongs to the Second profile

assertions.label: the-round-trip-happened
assertions.desc: gate: Alpha, then Bravo, then Alpha again

assertions.label: alpha-before-the-trip
assertions.desc: control: one profile, one timer, a slow drift

assertions.label: alpha-after-the-trip
assertions.desc: THE MEASUREMENT: the ambient drift moves the sidebar mean under 1 per frame. Two timers painting two themes on one window jump it by far more
